WHAT: Maestro CLI v2.3.0 installed at ~/.maestro/bin, requires Java 17
FIX FOR BARE maestro COMMAND:
- sudo ln -sf ~/.maestro/bin/maestro /opt/homebrew/bin/maestro
- sudo ln -sf /opt/homebrew/opt/openjdk@17/bin/java /opt/homebrew/bin/java
- echo 'export JAVA_HOME=/opt/homebrew/opt/openjdk@17' >> ~/.zshrc
RUN TESTS:
  maestro test .maestro/flows/app/
  maestro test .maestro/flows/keyboard/setup-keyboard.yaml
GOTCHA: Before symlinking, every call needed 'source ~/.zshrc' prefix. After symlinking, bare 'maestro' works in any shell including Claude Code Bash tool.
